messages:
alex k.: Deploy bot kicking off phased rollout v1.12.3 -> 10% eu-west1

deploy-bot: [deploy] @channel starting rollout
```
rollout id: r-20260320-185
variant: v1.12.3
region: eu-west1
pct: 10
pin: false
```

maria d.: running smoke tests now, will report in ~2m
sanjay r.: watching latency + errors; set a short-lived dashboard snapshot and alert for 95th latency
ops-oncall: saw one kvcache OOM on canary-2 at +00:58, auto-action: pinned canary-2 to prior version and removed it from rotation
eng-release-lead: hold progression — need RCA for OOM, do NOT advance to 20% until we understand scope
alex k.: acknowledged. pin traffic at 10% and pause autoscale for the rollout group. rollback candidate prepared if repeats
deploy-bot: action taken: rolled back instance canary-2 -> v1.12.2, traffic rebalanced across remaining canaries
maria d.: smoke tests pass on remaining canaries, no errors in logs for 3m (sampling of 50 requests)
sanjay r.: latency up ~3% overall, still within SLO; error rate 0.12% vs baseline 0.08% — watching for trend
eng-release-lead: ok, tentative resume in 10m if no new OOMs. request signoff from oncall + release lead before increasing pct
ops-oncall: +1 from oncall, will escalate immediately on any recurrence
alex k.: adding changelog note: https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/v1.12.3 — rollout window 20:00-21:00 UTC; pin/rollback plan ready
maria d.: coordinating canary-level sampling for regression eval sets, pushing results to /releases/1.12.3/evals
alex k.: plan: resume to 25% in 10m if green, otherwise hold and trigger extended investigation
eng-release-lead: go — proceed slowly, keep pinned fallback ready and keep this thread open for any new signals

:thumbsup: reactions from @maria d., @sanjay r., @ops-oncall
